Second release of `finlab`, a Python toolkit for the methods in Marcos López de Prado's *Advances in Financial Machine Learning*. Changes since 0.1.0 are listed below; the full changelog is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/landtml/finlab-ml/blob/v0.1.1/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/landtml/finlab-ml@v0.1.1"
# with plotting and the example notebooks
pip install "finlab[plot,notebooks] @ git+https://github.com/landtml/finlab-ml@v0.1.1"
```

## Added

- Trial records (`finlab.trials`): `TrialRecord` and `TrialRegistry` count the trials and feed the performance matrix to PBO and the number of trials to the deflated Sharpe ratio.
- `DeflatedSharpeResult` and `deflated_sharpe`, with validated inputs. PBO and deflated Sharpe results render as HTML tables in notebooks.
- Plotting (`finlab.plot`, optional `plot` extra): plotly figures for PBO, the deflated Sharpe ratio and the Monte Carlo experiment.
- Worked notebooks in `examples/` for PBO, the deflated Sharpe ratio with trial records, the Monte Carlo experiment and fractional differentiation. CI executes them.
- Gallery figures in `docs/images/`, shown in the README.
- Ruff linting, `plot` and `notebooks` extras, and CI jobs that install the built wheel with and without the extras.

## Changed

- The Monte Carlo trial draws use numpy directly. End to end, one trial takes 54.0 µs against 207.0 µs for a dense NumPy trial with the same seeds (measured on a shared 4-vCPU machine).
- The Monte Carlo experiment follows AFML Snippets 4.7 and 4.8.
- The README benchmark table is re-measured, and each row names its script in `benchmarks/`.

## Fixed

- `probability_of_backtest_overfitting` rejects non-integer and boolean `n_partitions` before use, and detects zero-variance columns exactly.
- The test suite gives each run a fresh numba cache.
- The proof notes correct the runs-bar Jensen condition, the HRP bisection cost bound and the minTRL check.
- The HRP distance and the zero-variance note in `TrialRegistry` match the code.

## Known limitations

See the [known limitations in CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/landtml/finlab-ml/blob/v0.1.1/CHANGELOG.md#011---2026-10-10).
